visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair pulled back poses while sitting in a white, arched window frame. She wears a traditional Thai costume consisting of a gold-embroidered cream top and a green patterned skirt. She smiles at the camera, showing gold earrings and a matching headpiece. (2) The scene shifts to the exterior of a Thai temple (Wat Arun) where she poses again in a slightly different gold and white costume. (3) She is seen walking towards and entering a shop named 'Wangdoem Station' with 'COSTUME RENTAL SHOP' written on the glass. (4) Inside the shop, she browses through many colorful fabric rolls on racks. A staff member in a green shirt helps her select and drape a green fabric. (5) Detailed shots of gold bracelets being placed on her arm. She is then seen sitting for makeup as a stylist applies blush and eyeshadow. (6) A hair stylist teases her hair upward, creating a voluminous look; the woman looks into the lens with a comical, slightly nervous expression. (7) She is shown fully dressed again at the temple, holding a white paper umbrella. (8) She rides in the back of a green and white tuk-tuk towards the temple gates. (9) She pays for tickets and gets a red stamp on her hand. (10) A male photographer in a blue vest with '041' on the back takes photos of her with a DSLR. (11) A montage of her posing with the umbrella against the ornate temple background. (12) She looks at a phone screen showing a gallery of photos. (13) In the final scene, she stands with another woman, both in Thai traditional dress, laughing and talking directly to the camera.
